name: Single Runner
description: Executes a pipeline with strict single-instance semantics, ensuring only one runner processes a given record or job at a time. Prevents duplicate side effects when multiple runners might otherwise pick up the same work.
when_to_use: Work items must be processed exactly once per attempt
Side effects (charges, emails) cannot tolerate duplicates
use_cases: Cron-style scheduled jobs with lease locks
Kafka compacted log with consumer-group coordination
Database row-level locks for batch updates
